name: verify
description: Verify the code you ship: a seven-lane blind scanner ensemble (semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, OSV-Scanner, zizmor, an open-ended model review and a threat-model-driven source-to-sink model audit) whose serious candidates face a blind three-lens verification panel and a computed gate, triaged into one ranked SARIF with a coverage receipt; CodeQL CI setup and read-back; and autonomous Strix DAST pentesting — results into .ai-security/results for remediation.
